summary: The test suite covers core parsing, checking, and reporting logic well but fails a critical requirement: the task mandates 'ALL TESTS MUST RUN THROUGH ACT,' yet workflow.test.ts only validates YAML structure and actionlint—it does not execute the workflow through act, capture output to act-result.txt, or verify end-to-end behavior. Tests skip CLI integration (main() function untested), file I/O error scenarios, edge cases in version parsing (inline comments, complex specifiers), and dependency names with special characters. The suite would not catch CI/CD pipeline failures or integration issues. Design is clean (good mocks, organization, independence), but insufficient rigor and missing the mandatory act integration make this untrustworthy for regression detection in the actual deployment context.
